points.description: Hue is centred around green, about 120 degrees.
points.partial_credit: Says green hue is used but gives no value or a vague range.

points.description: Intensity and saturation are both set to a mid range, around 0.5 (saturation moderate/low because of the blackish stem).
points.partial_credit: Gives only one of intensity or saturation correctly.

rubric.notes: Full marks: hue near 120° (green) plus intensity and saturation around 0.5 (or low/moderate saturation), in any wording. Give 1 mark if only the hue is right, or only the intensity/saturation part is right, or both are stated vaguely. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
